title: Creamy Bacon Chicken
instructions: Step 1: Slice up the bacon and cook it in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy. Remove to a paper-towel-lined plate.
Step 2: Season chicken on both sides with your favorite chicken seasoning and cook it in the bacon grease until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Step 3: Remove chicken from the pan and leave the drippings.
Step 4: Whisk 2 tablespoons of flour into the drippings and let it cook for a few minutes to remove the raw flour taste.
Step 5: Slowly whisk in the chicken broth and heavy cream.
Step 6: Add in the onion powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper, then let the sauce simmer until it thickens (just a few minutes).
Step 7: Stir in the crumbled bacon, then add the chicken back into the sauce.
Step 8: Serve over rice or mashed potatoes and enjoy.
notes: From Mamas Down South Kitchen (Facebook/Instagram). Recipe was posted as the creator's own reply under her post rather than a separate first comment. She also shared a Walmart affiliate grocery list link: https://walmrt.us/4dASAPl
